summary: This RFC defines a Deprecation HTTP response header field that tells API clients a resource is, or will be, deprecated. It also defines a "deprecation" link relation that can point to documentation about the deprecation. Together they let services warn clients automatically before something goes away.

eli5.summary: It is like a sticker on a toy saying "we will stop making this soon." Programs that use a web service can read the sticker and know it is time to switch.

questions: how to signal an api is deprecated in http
